title: Driver Compensation Schedule: Lost Driving Time in a Cleaning and Damage Fees Cleaning Charge
content:
**Rule.** The lost driving time of a Cleaning and Damage Fees cleaning fee approved at review is worked out from the level held and the evidence on file: when the level held assumes the vehicle was taken offline and a professional cleaning document is on the evidence ledger, it is the daily lost-time rate for each calendar day from the reported trip's drop-off date through the date of the latest professional cleaning document, both days counted; when the level assumes the vehicle was taken offline and no professional cleaning document is on file, it is the daily lost-time rate for one day; when the level does not assume the vehicle was taken offline, there is no lost driving time.

The daily lost-time rate is $30.00. The lost driving time is added to the amount the fee charged on approval is based on, before the fee is held to its ceiling.

## Levels and the offline assumption

| Cleaning level held | Vehicle assumed taken offline |
|---|---|
| Cleaning Fee Level 1 (Minor) | No — no lost driving time |
| Cleaning Fee Level 2 (Moderate) | No — no lost driving time |
| Cleaning Fee Level 3 (Significant) | Yes |
| Cleaning Fee Level 4 (Major) | Yes |

(Both damage levels also assume the vehicle was taken offline.)

## The dates

- **Drop-off date.** The date of the drop-off moment on the trip record in Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares).
- **Latest professional cleaning document.** The date of the latest cleaning receipt submission on the assessment's evidence ledger.
- **Days counted.** Every calendar day from the drop-off date through that document date, the first and the last both counted.

## Illustrations (hypothetical)

| Level held | Drop-off date | Latest cleaning receipt submission | Days | Lost driving time |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Level 3 | 10 May | 13 May | 4 | $120.00 |
| Level 4 | 10 May | 10 May | 1 | $30.00 |
| Level 3 | 10 May | none on the ledger | 1 | $30.00 |
| Level 2 | 10 May | 12 May | — | none |
